886: I frequently sit down to the tables of the brethren and sisters, and see that they use a great amount of milk and sugar. These clog the system, irritate the digestive organs, and affect the brain. Anything that hinders the active motion of the living machinery affects the brain very directly. And from the light given me, sugar, when largely used, is more injurious than meat. These changes should be made cautiously, and the subject should be treated in a manner not calculated to disgust and prejudice those whom we would teach and help.
我常常坐在弟兄姊妹的飯桌前，看見他們用了大量的牛奶和糖。這些東西阻塞身體、刺激消化器官，並影響腦子。凡妨礙這具活機器順暢運轉的，都會直接影響腦子。照所指示我的亮光，糖若大量使用，比肉還要有害。這些改變應當謹慎地進行，講論這題目的方式，也不可叫我們所要教導幫助的人反感、生出成見。
我常常坐在弟兄姊妹的饭桌前，看见他们用了大量的牛奶和糖。这些东西阻塞身体、刺激消化器官，并影响脑子。凡妨碍这具活机器顺畅运转的，都会直接影响脑子。照所指示我的亮光，糖若大量使用，比肉还要有害。这些改变应当谨慎地进行，讲论这题目的方式，也不可叫我们所要教导帮助的人反感、生出成见。
887: Our sisters often do not know how to cook. To such I would say: I would go to the very best cook that could be found in the country, and remain there if necessary for weeks, until I had become mistress of the art, an intelligent, skillful cook. I would pursue this course if I were forty years old. It is your duty to know how to cook, and it is your duty to teach your daughters to cook. When you are teaching them the art of cookery you are building around them a barrier that will preserve them from the folly and vice which they may otherwise be tempted to engage in. I prize my seamstress, I value my copyist; but my cook, who knows well how to prepare the food to sustain life and nourish brain, bone, and muscle, fills the most important place among the helpers in my family.

我們的姊妹往往不會煮飯。我要對這樣的人說：我會去找全國最好的廚師，必要時在那裡住上幾個星期，直到我學會這門手藝，成為一個有見識、有本事的廚師。即使我已四十歲，我還是要這樣做。學會煮飯是你的本分，教你的女兒煮飯也是你的本分。你教她們烹調的手藝時，等於在她們四圍築起一道牆，保守她們不去做那些原可能被引誘去做的愚妄敗壞之事。我看重我的女裁縫，我器重我的抄寫員；但我的廚師——那懂得怎樣預備食物來維持生命、滋養腦、骨、肌肉的人——在我家的幫手中占著最要緊的位置。

我们的姊妹往往不会煮饭。我要对这样的人说：我会去找全国最好的厨师，必要时在那里住上几个星期，直到我学会这门手艺，成为一个有见识、有本事的厨师。即使我已四十岁，我还是要这样做。学会煮饭是你的本分，教你的女儿煮饭也是你的本分。你教她们烹调的手艺时，等于在她们四围筑起一道墙，保守她们不去做那些原可能被引诱去做的愚妄败坏之事。我看重我的女裁缝，我器重我的抄写员；但我的厨师——那懂得怎样预备食物来维持生命、滋养脑、骨、肌肉的人——在我家的帮手中占着最要紧的位置。
888: Mothers, there is nothing that leads to such evils as to lift the burdens from your daughters, and give them nothing special to do, and let them choose their own employment, perhaps a little crochet or some other fancywork to busy themselves. Let them have exercise of the limbs and muscles. If it wearies them, what then? Are you not wearied in your work? Will weariness hurt your children, unless overworked, more than it hurts you? No, indeed. They can recover from their weariness in a good night’s rest and be prepared to engage in labor the next day. It is a sin to let them grow up in idleness. The sin and ruin of Sodom was abundance of bread and idleness.
作母親的，最容易招致禍害的，莫過於把擔子從女兒身上卸下來，不給她們甚麼正經事做，任憑她們自己找事消遣，也許就是一點鉤織或別的手工。要讓她們的手腳筋骨得著運動。累了又怎樣呢？你自己工作不也會累嗎？只要不是過勞，疲累對你的孩子難道比對你更有害嗎？絕不會。一夜好眠就能解乏，第二天又可以做工了。任憑他們在閒懶中長大，是一種罪。所多瑪的罪惡與敗亡，就是糧食飽足、閒懶度日。
作母亲的，最容易招致祸害的，莫过于把担子从女儿身上卸下来，不给她们甚么正经事做，任凭她们自己找事消遣，也许就是一点钩织或别的手工。要让她们的手脚筋骨得着运动。累了又怎样呢？你自己工作不也会累吗？只要不是过劳，疲累对你的孩子难道比对你更有害吗？绝不会。一夜好眠就能解乏，第二天又可以做工了。任凭他们在闲懒中长大，是一种罪。所多玛的罪恶与败亡，就是粮食饱足、闲懒度日。
889: We want to work from the right standpoint. We want to act like men and women that are to be brought into judgment. And when we adopt the health reform we should adopt it from a sense of duty, not because somebody else has adopted it. I have not changed my course a particle since I adopted the health reform. I have not taken one step back since the light from heaven upon this subject first shone upon my pathway. I broke away from everything at once,—from meat and butter, and from three meals,—and that while engaged in exhaustive brain labor, writing from early morning till sundown. I came down to two meals a day without changing my labor. I have been a great sufferer from disease, having had five shocks of paralysis. I have been with my left arm bound to my side for months because the pain in my heart was so great. When making these changes in my diet, I refused to yield to taste and let that govern me. Shall that stand in the way of my securing greater strength, that I may therewith glorify my Lord? Shall that stand in my way for a moment? Never! I suffered keen hunger. I was a great meat eater. But when faint, I placed my arms across my stomach and said: “I will not taste a morsel. I will eat simple food, or I will not eat at all.” Bread was distasteful to me. I could seldom eat a piece as large as a dollar. Some things in the reform I could get along with very well, but when I came to the bread I was especially set against it. When I made these changes I had a special battle to fight. The first two or three meals, I could not eat. I said to my stomach: “You may wait until you can eat bread.” In a little while I could eat bread, and graham bread, too. This I could not eat before; but now it tastes good, and I have had no loss of appetite.

我們做事要站對立場。我們要像將來要受審判的人那樣行事。我們接受健康改良，應當出於本分感，不是因為別人接受了。自從我接受健康改良以來，我沒有更動過分毫。自從天上關於這題目的亮光第一次照在我路上，我沒有退過一步。我一下子把一切都斷了——肉食、奶油，還有一日三餐——而那時我正在做極耗腦力的工作，從清早寫到日落。我改成一天兩餐，工作卻沒有減少。我素來受疾病之苦，曾五度遭受癱瘓的襲擊。我曾把左臂縛在身側好幾個月，因為心口疼得太厲害。改變飲食的時候，我不肯讓口味來支配我。難道要讓口味攔阻我得著更大的力氣、好用這力氣榮耀我的主嗎？難道要讓它攔阻我片刻嗎？絕不！我嘗過劇烈的飢餓。我本是個嗜吃肉的人。但每逢發昏的時候，我就把兩臂交叉按在胃上，說：「我一口也不吃。我要吃簡單的食物，不然就甚麼都不吃。」麵包我吃不下去。我很少能吃下一塊像銀元那麼大的。改良中有些項目我還過得去，唯獨麵包這一項，我特別抗拒。做這些改變時，我打了一場硬仗。頭兩三餐我根本吃不下。我對我的胃說：「你就等著吧，等到你能吃麵包為止。」沒過多久我就能吃麵包了，連全麥麵包也能吃。這是我從前吃不下的；如今卻覺得可口，胃口也沒有絲毫減退。

我们做事要站对立场。我们要像将来要受审判的人那样行事。我们接受健康改良，应当出于本分感，不是因为别人接受了。自从我接受健康改良以来，我没有更动过分毫。自从天上关于这题目的亮光第一次照在我路上，我没有退过一步。我一下子把一切都断了——肉食、奶油，还有一日三餐——而那时我正在做极耗脑力的工作，从清早写到日落。我改成一天两餐，工作却没有减少。我素来受疾病之苦，曾五度遭受瘫痪的袭击。我曾把左臂缚在身侧好几个月，因为心口疼得太厉害。改变饮食的时候，我不肯让口味来支配我。难道要让口味拦阻我得着更大的力气、好用这力气荣耀我的主吗？难道要让它拦阻我片刻吗？绝不！我尝过剧烈的饥饿。我本是个嗜吃肉的人。但每逢发昏的时候，我就把两臂交叉按在胃上，说：「我一口也不吃。我要吃简单的食物，不然就甚么都不吃。」面包我吃不下去。我很少能吃下一块像银元那么大的。改良中有些项目我还过得去，唯独面包这一项，我特别抗拒。做这些改变时，我打了一场硬仗。头两三餐我根本吃不下。我对我的胃说：「你就等着吧，等到你能吃面包为止。」没过多久我就能吃面包了，连全麦面包也能吃。这是我从前吃不下的；如今却觉得可口，胃口也没有丝毫减退。
890: When writing Spiritual Gifts, volumes three and four, I would become exhausted by excessive labor. I then saw that I must change my course of life, and by resting a few days I came out all right again. I left off these things from principle. I took my stand on health reform from principle. And since that time, brethren, you have not heard me advance an extreme view of health reform that I have had to take back. I have advanced nothing but what I stand to today. I recommend to you a healthful, nourishing diet.
我寫《屬靈的恩賜》第三、四卷的時候，常因勞作過度而精疲力竭。那時我看出必須改變生活方式；休息幾天，我就完全復原了。我戒掉這些東西是出於原則。我在健康改良上所站的立場是出於原則。弟兄們，從那時起，你們沒有聽過我在健康改良上發表甚麼極端的看法而後來又收回的。我所主張的，直到今日仍站得住。我向你們推薦的，是有益健康、能滋養身體的飲食。
我写《属灵的恩赐》第三、四卷的时候，常因劳作过度而精疲力竭。那时我看出必须改变生活方式；休息几天，我就完全复原了。我戒掉这些东西是出于原则。我在健康改良上所站的立场是出于原则。弟兄们，从那时起，你们没有听过我在健康改良上发表甚么极端的看法而后来又收回的。我所主张的，直到今日仍站得住。我向你们推荐的，是有益健康、能滋养身体的饮食。
891: I do not regard it a great privation to discontinue the use of those things which leave a bad smell in the breath and a bad taste in the mouth. Is it self-denial to leave these things and get into a condition where everything is as sweet as honey; where no bad taste is left in the mouth and no feeling of goneness in the stomach? These I used to have much of the time. I have fainted away with my child in my arms again and again. I have none of this now, and shall I call this a privation when I can stand before you as I do this day? There is not one woman in a hundred that could endure the amount of labor that I do. I moved out from principle, not from impulse. I moved because I believed Heaven would approve of the course I was taking to bring myself into the very best condition of health, that I might glorify God in my body and spirit, which are His.

把那些叫口氣難聞、口中發苦的東西戒掉，我不覺得是甚麼大犧牲。離開這些，進入一種口中甘甜如蜜、沒有怪味、胃裡也不再空虛發慌的光景——這算是克己嗎？從前我大半時候都有那種難受。我曾抱著孩子一次又一次地昏倒。如今我全然沒有這些了；我既能像今天這樣站在你們面前，難道還要把這叫作犧牲嗎？一百個婦人中，沒有一個能承受我所做的工作量。我是憑原則挪動的，不是憑一時衝動。我這樣做，是因為我相信上天會嘉許我所走的路——把自己帶進最好的健康狀況，好在我的身體和心靈上榮耀上帝，因為這身體和心靈都是屬祂的。

把那些叫口气难闻、口中发苦的东西戒掉，我不觉得是甚么大牺牲。离开这些，进入一种口中甘甜如蜜、没有怪味、胃里也不再空虚发慌的光景——这算是克己吗？从前我大半时候都有那种难受。我曾抱着孩子一次又一次地昏倒。如今我全然没有这些了；我既能像今天这样站在你们面前，难道还要把这叫作牺牲吗？一百个妇人中，没有一个能承受我所做的工作量。我是凭原则挪动的，不是凭一时冲动。我这样做，是因为我相信上天会嘉许我所走的路——把自己带进最好的健康状况，好在我的身体和心灵上荣耀上帝，因为这身体和心灵都是属祂的。
892: We can have a variety of good, wholesome food, cooked in a healthful manner, so that it can be made palatable to all. And if you, my sisters, do not know how to cook, I advise you to learn. It is of vital importance to you to know how to cook. There are more souls lost from poor cooking than you have any idea of. It produces sickness, disease, and bad tempers; the system becomes deranged, and heavenly things cannot be discerned. There is more religion in a loaf of good bread than many of you think. There is more religion in good cooking than you have any idea of. We want you to learn what good religion is, and to carry it out in your families. When I have been from home sometimes, I have known that the bread upon the table, and the food generally, would hurt me; but I would be obliged to eat a little to sustain life. It is a sin in the sight of Heaven to have such food. I have suffered for want of proper food. For a dyspeptic stomach, you may place upon your tables fruits of different kinds, but not too many at one meal. In this way you may have a variety, and it will taste good, and after you have eaten your meals you will feel well.

我們可以有各樣美好而有益的食物，用健康的方法烹調，叫人人都覺得可口。我的姊妹們，你們若不會煮飯，我勸你們去學。懂得煮飯，對你們是極其要緊的。因著煮得不好而失喪的生靈，比你們所想的多得多。它招來疾病、招來壞脾氣；身體失調，屬天的事就無從領會。一條好麵包裡所含的信仰，比你們許多人所想的多。好的烹調裡所含的信仰，遠超過你們的想像。我們願你們認識甚麼是真正的信仰，並把它實行在自己家中。我不在家的時候，有時明知桌上的麵包和整體的食物會傷害我，卻不得不吃一點來維持生命。擺出這樣的食物，在上天看來是一種罪。我曾因缺乏合宜的食物而受苦。腸胃不好的人，桌上可以擺幾樣不同的水果，但一餐不要擺太多。這樣就可以有變化，吃起來也可口；飯後你會覺得舒服。

我们可以有各样美好而有益的食物，用健康的方法烹调，叫人人都觉得可口。我的姊妹们，你们若不会煮饭，我劝你们去学。懂得煮饭，对你们是极其要紧的。因着煮得不好而失丧的生灵，比你们所想的多得多。它招来疾病、招来坏脾气；身体失调，属天的事就无从领会。一条好面包里所含的信仰，比你们许多人所想的多。好的烹调里所含的信仰，远超过你们的想像。我们愿你们认识甚么是真正的信仰，并把它实行在自己家中。我不在家的时候，有时明知桌上的面包和整体的食物会伤害我，却不得不吃一点来维持生命。摆出这样的食物，在上天看来是一种罪。我曾因缺乏合宜的食物而受苦。肠胃不好的人，桌上可以摆几样不同的水果，但一餐不要摆太多。这样就可以有变化，吃起来也可口；饭后你会觉得舒服。
893: I am astonished to learn that, after all the light that has been given in this place, many of you eat between meals! You should never let a morsel pass your lips between your regular meals. Eat what you ought, but eat it at one meal, and then wait until the next. I eat enough to satisfy the wants of nature; but when I get up from the table, my appetite is just as good as when I sat down. And when the next meal comes, I am ready to take my portion, and no more. Should I eat a double amount now and then, because it tastes good, how could I bow down and ask God to help me in my work of writing, when I could not get an idea on account of my gluttony? Could I ask God to take care of that unreasonable load upon my stomach? That would be dishonoring Him. That would be asking to consume upon my lust. Now I eat just what I think is right, and then I can ask Him to give me strength to perform the work that He has given me to do. And I have known that Heaven has heard and answered my prayer when I have offered this petition.

我很驚訝地得知，這地方已經有了這麼多亮光，你們當中卻仍有許多人在兩餐之間吃東西！在正餐之間，你絕不該讓一口食物入口。該吃的就吃，但要在一餐裡吃完，然後等到下一餐。我吃到足夠應付身體的需要為止；但離席的時候，我的胃口跟坐下時一樣好。等下一餐來到，我就預備好吃我那一份，不多吃。我若因為東西可口就偶爾吃上雙倍的量，等到因為飽食而想不出一個念頭的時候，我怎能俯伏求上帝幫助我寫作的工作呢？我能求上帝來照管我胃裡那不合理的負擔嗎？那是羞辱祂，那是求祂供我放縱私慾。如今我只吃我認為合宜的分量，然後就能求祂賜我力量，去完成祂交給我的工作。我也曾親身知道，我這樣祈求的時候，上天垂聽並應允了我的禱告。

我很惊讶地得知，这地方已经有了这么多亮光，你们当中却仍有许多人在两餐之间吃东西！在正餐之间，你绝不该让一口食物入口。该吃的就吃，但要在一餐里吃完，然后等到下一餐。我吃到足够应付身体的需要为止；但离席的时候，我的胃口跟坐下时一样好。等下一餐来到，我就预备好吃我那一份，不多吃。我若因为东西可口就偶尔吃上双倍的量，等到因为饱食而想不出一个念头的时候，我怎能俯伏求上帝帮助我写作的工作呢？我能求上帝来照管我胃里那不合理的负担吗？那是羞辱祂，那是求祂供我放纵私欲。如今我只吃我认为合宜的分量，然后就能求祂赐我力量，去完成祂交给我的工作。我也曾亲身知道，我这样祈求的时候，上天垂听并应允了我的祷告。
894: Again, when we eat immoderately, we sin against our own bodies. Upon the Sabbath, in the house of God, gluttons will sit and sleep under the burning truths of God’s word. They can neither keep their eyes open, nor comprehend the solemn discourses given. Do you think that such are glorifying God in their bodies and spirits, which are His? No; they dishonor Him. And the dyspeptic—what has made him dyspeptic is taking this course. Instead of observing regularity, he has let appetite control him, and has eaten between meals. Perhaps, if his habits are sedentary, he has not had the vitalizing air of heaven to help in the work of digestion; he may not have had sufficient exercise for his health.

再者，我們吃得無節制，就是得罪自己的身體。安息日在上帝的殿中，貪食的人會坐在那裡，在上帝話語火熱的真理下打瞌睡。他們既睜不開眼睛，也領會不了所講的嚴肅道理。你以為這樣的人是在他們的身體和心靈上榮耀上帝嗎——這身體和心靈原是屬祂的？不，他們是羞辱祂。至於那腸胃不好的人——使他腸胃不好的，正是這種做法。他不守規律，任憑食慾支配自己，在兩餐之間吃東西。他若又是久坐少動，也許就沒有得著上天那使人有活力的空氣來幫助消化；他也可能沒有得著足夠維持健康的運動。

再者，我们吃得无节制，就是得罪自己的身体。安息日在上帝的殿中，贪食的人会坐在那里，在上帝话语火热的真理下打瞌睡。他们既睁不开眼睛，也领会不了所讲的严肃道理。你以为这样的人是在他们的身体和心灵上荣耀上帝吗——这身体和心灵原是属祂的？不，他们是羞辱祂。至于那肠胃不好的人——使他肠胃不好的，正是这种做法。他不守规律，任凭食欲支配自己，在两餐之间吃东西。他若又是久坐少动，也许就没有得着上天那使人有活力的空气来帮助消化；他也可能没有得着足够维持健康的运动。
914: It is an error generally committed to make no difference in the life of a woman previous to the birth of her children. At this important period the labor of the mother should be lightened. Great changes are going on in her system. It requires a greater amount of blood, and therefore an increase of food of the most nourishing quality to convert into blood. Unless she has an abundant supply of nutritious food, she cannot retain her physical strength, and her offspring is robbed of vitality. Her clothing also demands attention. Care should be taken to protect the body from a sense of chilliness. She should not call vitality unnecessarily to the surface to supply the want of sufficient clothing. If the mother is deprived of an abundance of wholesome, nutritious food, she will lack in the quantity and quality of blood. Her circulation will be poor, and her child will lack in the very same things. There will be an inability in the offspring to appropriate food which it can convert into good blood to nourish the system. The prosperity of mother and child depends much upon good, warm clothing and a supply of nourishing food. The extra draft upon the vitality of the mother must be considered and provided for.

認為婦女在分娩前的生活與平時毫無二致，乃是常見的錯誤。 在這重要的時期，應該竭力減輕母親的操勞。她的體內正起著極大 的變化。她需要更大量的血液，因此必須多吃那些富有營養的食物， 好使其轉化為血液。如果不充分地供給她營養豐富的食物，她就無 法維持體力，而結果她兒女的精力便被剝奪了。她的衣著也必須加 以注意。應該十分謹慎，免得身體受涼。她不可因穿著不夠的衣服 而無謂地將熱量消耗在皮膚上面。母親如果得不到充分增進健康而 富有營養的食物，則她血液的質和量都必有所缺欠。她血脈的迴圈 必欠佳，而且她的孩子也必有同樣的情形。她的兒女必不能使所進 用的食物變成良好的血液以保養身體系統。母子的健壯大半基於良 · · 好而暖和的衣服，以及富有營養的食物。應當體諒產婦身體比常人 有更多的消耗，而予以供應和補充。

认为妇女在分娩前的生活与平时毫无二致，乃是常见的错误。 在这重要的时期，应该竭力减轻母亲的操劳。她的体内正起着极大 的变化。她需要更大量的血液，因此必须多吃那些富有营养的食物， 好使其转化为血液。如果不充分地供给她营养丰富的食物，她就无 法维持体力，而结果她儿女的精力便被剥夺了。她的衣着也必须加 以注意。应该十分谨慎，免得身体受凉。她不可因穿着不够的衣服 而无谓地将热量消耗在皮肤上面。母亲如果得不到充分增进健康而 富有营养的食物，则她血液的质和量都必有所缺欠。她血脉的循环 必欠佳，而且她的孩子也必有同样的情形。她的儿女必不能使所进 用的食物变成良好的血液以保养身体系统。母子的健壮大半基于良 · · 好而暖和的衣服，以及富有营养的食物。应当体谅产妇身体比常人 有更多的消耗，而予以供应和补充。
915: But, on the other hand, the idea that women, because of their special condition, may let the appetite run riot, is a mistake based on custom, but not on sound sense. The appetite of women in this condition may be variable, fitful, and difficult to gratify; and custom allows her to have anything she may fancy, without consulting reason as to whether such food can supply nutrition for her body and for the growth of her child. The food should be nutritious, but should not be of an exciting quality. Custom says that if she wants flesh meats, pickles, spiced food, or mince pies, let her have them; appetite alone is to be consulted. This is a great mistake, and does much harm. The harm cannot be estimated. If ever there is need of simplicity of diet and special care as to the quality of food eaten, it is in this important period.

但是，從另一方面來說，如果因為孕婦的特殊情況，便讓她放 縱食慾，大吃大喝，這卻是基於習俗、而與純正理性無關的一種錯 誤。妊娠期中的婦女，食慾變化多端，沒有定數，很難滿足。照一 般的習俗，便是讓她想吃什麼吃什麼，不向理性請教這等食物是否 給她的身體和胎兒生長供應適當的營養。孕婦的食物應當富有營養， 但卻不應有刺激性。習俗的說法，如果她要肉食、醃漬品，或是香 料濃烈的食物和肉餅，都當讓她吃，只要她有胃口就行。這實在是 一種大錯，而且害處甚多，簡直無法估計。若是有一個時期是需要 簡樸的飲食和特別注意食物的質量，那就是這個十分重要的妊娠時 期了。

但是，从另一方面来说，如果因为孕妇的特殊情况，便让她放 纵食欲，大吃大喝，这却是基于习俗、而与纯正理性无关的一种错 误。妊娠期中的妇女，食欲变化多端，没有定数，很难满足。照一 般的习俗，便是让她想吃什么吃什么，不向理性请教这等食物是否 给她的身体和胎儿生长供应适当的营养。孕妇的食物应当富有营养， 但却不应有刺激性。习俗的说法，如果她要肉食、腌渍品，或是香 料浓烈的食物和肉饼，都当让她吃，只要她有胃口就行。这实在是 一种大错，而且害处甚多，简直无法估计。若是有一个时期是需要 简朴的饮食和特别注意食物的质量，那就是这个十分重要的妊娠时 期了。
916: Women who possess principle, and who are well instructed, will not depart from simplicity of diet at this time of all others. They will consider that another life is dependent upon them, and will be careful in all their habits, and especially in diet. They should not eat that which is innutritious and exciting, simply because it tastes good. There are too many counselors ready to persuade them to do things which reason would tell them they ought not to do.
凡是注重原則且受過良好指教的婦女，在這種時期絕不會稍離 飲食簡樸的習慣，正如在其他時期一樣。她們必考慮到另有一條生 命仰賴著她們，也必注意她們的一切生活習慣，特別是飲食習慣。 她們不可進用那些雖然美味可口，卻毫無營養而含有刺激性的食物。 太多的顧問都準備勸她們去作那些理智告訴她們不該作的事。
凡是注重原则且受过良好指教的妇女，在这种时期绝不会稍离 饮食简朴的习惯，正如在其他时期一样。她们必考虑到另有一条生 命仰赖着她们，也必注意她们的一切生活习惯，特别是饮食习惯。 她们不可进用那些虽然美味可口，却毫无营养而含有刺激性的食物。 太多的顾问都准备劝她们去作那些理智告诉她们不该作的事。
917: Diseased children are born because of the gratification of appetite by the parents. The system did not demand the variety of food upon which the mind dwelt. Because once in the mind it must be in the stomach, is a great error, which Christian women should reject. Imagination should not be allowed to control the wants of the system. Those who allow the taste to rule, will suffer the penalty of transgressing the laws of their being. And the matter does not end here; their innocent offspring also will be sufferers.
由於父母放縱食慾，許多孩子生來就患有疾病。我們的身體並 不是你想吃什麼，就需要什麼。想吃什麼就必須吃什麼乃是基督徒 女性們應當拒絕的一個大錯誤。不應讓想象來控制身體的需要。凡 讓口味當家的人，必因干犯其生命律法之罪而受苦；而且其害不止 於此，她們無辜的兒女也會同蒙其害。
由于父母放纵食欲，许多孩子生来就患有疾病。我们的身体并 不是你想吃什么，就需要什么。想吃什么就必须吃什么乃是基督徒 女性们应当拒绝的一个大错误。不应让想象来控制身体的需要。凡 让口味当家的人，必因干犯其生命律法之罪而受苦；而且其害不止 于此，她们无辜的儿女也会同蒙其害。
918: The blood-making organs cannot convert spices, mince pies, pickles, and diseased flesh meats into good blood. And if so much food is taken into the stomach that the digestive organs are compelled to overwork in order to dispose of it and to free the system from irritating substances, the mother does injustice to herself and lays the foundation of disease in her offspring. If she chooses to eat as she pleases, and what she may fancy, irrespective of consequences, she will bear the penalty, but not alone. Her innocent child must suffer because of her indiscretion.
造血器官不能把香料、肉餅、醃漬品和病畜之肉變成良好的血 液。母親若吃了這麼多的食物，以致消化器官被迫過勞來處理以使 身體免遭刺激性食物之害，她不但對自己的身體不公道，也給兒女 奠下了多病的基礎。她若隨意進食，吃自己所幻想的東西，不顧後 果如何，她就一定要承受罪罰，而且受害的不只是她本人而已，她 · · 無辜的孩子，也必因她的糊塗不慎而受苦。
造血器官不能把香料、肉饼、腌渍品和病畜之肉变成良好的血 液。母亲若吃了这么多的食物，以致消化器官被迫过劳来处理以使 身体免遭刺激性食物之害，她不但对自己的身体不公道，也给儿女 奠下了多病的基础。她若随意进食，吃自己所幻想的东西，不顾后 果如何，她就一定要承受罪罚，而且受害的不只是她本人而已，她 · · 无辜的孩子，也必因她的糊涂不慎而受苦。
919: Great care should be exercised to have the surroundings of the mother pleasant and happy. The husband and father is under special responsibility to do all in his power to lighten the burden of the wife and mother. He should bear, as much as possible, the burden of her condition. He should be affable, courteous, kind, and tender, and specially attentive to all her wants. Not half the care is taken of some women while they are bearing children that is taken of animals in the stable.
母親所處的環境應當密切注意，務求使之舒適愉快。作丈夫和 父親的人負有特別的責任，要盡其所能地減輕妻子和母親的重擔。 他應該在可能範圍之內分負她健康方面的重擔。他須和藹，有禮， 親切，溫柔，特別注意她所有的需要。須知有些婦女在分娩時所得 到的照顧，還不如馬廄裡的牲口所得到的一半呢！
母亲所处的环境应当密切注意，务求使之舒适愉快。作丈夫和 父亲的人负有特别的责任，要尽其所能地减轻妻子和母亲的重担。 他应该在可能范围之内分负她健康方面的重担。他须和蔼，有礼， 亲切，温柔，特别注意她所有的需要。须知有些妇女在分娩时所得 到的照顾，还不如马厩里的牲口所得到的一半呢！
920: B has been very deficient. While in her best condition of health, his wife was not provided with a plenty of wholesome food and with proper clothing. Then, when she needed extra clothing and extra food, and that of a simple yet nutritious quality, it was not allowed her. Her system craved material to convert into blood, but he would not provide it. A moderate amount of milk and sugar, and a little salt, white bread raised with yeast for a change, graham flour prepared in a variety of ways by other hands than her own, plain cake with raisins, rice pudding with raisins, prunes, and figs, occasionally, and many other dishes I might mention, would have answered the demand of appetite. If he could not obtain some of these things, a little domestic wine would have done her no injury; it would have been better for her to have it than to do without it. In some cases, even a small amount of the least hurtful meat would do less injury than to suffer strong cravings for it.

B 在這方面非常欠缺。當他妻子的身體需要處於最佳健康狀況 時，卻得不到大量有益健康的食物和合適的衣服。當她需要特別的 衣服和特別好的食物時，卻不讓她有簡單清淡而又有營養的飲食。 她的身體渴求那些能變成血液的材料；他卻不供給她。其實，適量 的牛奶與糖加少量的鹽，用酵母發過的白麵包來變換一下，有時也 可請人用各種方法，以全麥麵粉烹製素的葡萄乾糕；用葡萄乾、洋 李乾和無花果制的米布丁，以及許多我可提出的別種餐食，都是可 以應付人食慾要求的。如果他無法得到這些東西，他可以給他妻子 準備一些葡萄汁。這比不給她要好。在某些情形下，與其讓人強烈 地渴望，倒不如提供少量極小害處的肉食

B 在这方面非常欠缺。当他妻子的身体需要处于最佳健康状况 时，却得不到大量有益健康的食物和合适的衣服。当她需要特别的 衣服和特别好的食物时，却不让她有简单清淡而又有营养的饮食。 她的身体渴求那些能变成血液的材料；他却不供给她。其实，适量 的牛奶与糖加少量的盐，用酵母发过的白面包来变换一下，有时也 可请人用各种方法，以全麦面粉烹制素的葡萄干糕；用葡萄干、洋 李干和无花果制的米布丁，以及许多我可提出的别种餐食，都是可 以应付人食欲要求的。如果他无法得到这些东西，他可以给他妻子 准备一些葡萄汁。这比不给她要好。在某些情形下，与其让人强烈 地渴望，倒不如提供少量极小害处的肉食
921: I was shown that both B and C have dishonored the cause of God. They have brought upon it a stain which will never be fully wiped out. I was shown the family of our dear Brother D. If this brother had received proper help at the right time, every member of his family would have been alive today. It is a wonder that the laws of the land have not been enforced in this instance of maltreatment. That family were perishing for food, the plainest, simplest food. They were starving in a land of plenty. A novice was practicing upon them. The young man did not die of disease, but of hunger. Food would have strengthened the system and kept the machinery in motion.

我蒙指示看到 B 和 C 兩位都已使上帝的聖工蒙羞。他們已使上 帝的工作蒙受永遠不能完全洗除的汙點。我又蒙指示看到我們親愛 的 D 弟兄的家庭。如果這位弟兄適時接受恰當的幫助，他的家人原 會活到今天。當地法律沒有制止這例虐待事件，真是令人不解。這 個家庭中的成員因為缺乏最普通、最簡單的食物而死亡。他們竟在 這個物產豐饒的地方餓死。一個新手在他們身上亂行其是。那青年 人不是死於疾病，而是死於飢餓。他身體原本可以藉著食物保持強 壯並富於機能。

我蒙指示看到 B 和 C 两位都已使上帝的圣工蒙羞。他们已使上 帝的工作蒙受永远不能完全洗除的污点。我又蒙指示看到我们亲爱 的 D 弟兄的家庭。如果这位弟兄适时接受恰当的帮助，他的家人原 会活到今天。当地法律没有制止这例虐待事件，真是令人不解。这 个家庭中的成员因为缺乏最普通、最简单的食物而死亡。他们竟在 这个物产丰饶的地方饿死。一个新手在他们身上乱行其是。那青年 人不是死于疾病，而是死于饥饿。他身体原本可以借着食物保持强 壮并富于机能。
922: In cases of severe fever, abstinence from food for a short time will lessen the fever and make the use of water more effectual. But the acting physician needs to understand the real condition of the patient and not allow him to be restricted in diet for a great length of time until his system becomes enfeebled. While the fever is raging, food may irritate and excite the blood; but as soon as the strength of the fever is broken, nourishment should be given in a careful, judicious manner. If food is withheld too long, the stomach’s craving for it will create fever, which will be relieved by a proper allowance of food of a right quality. It gives nature something to work upon. If there is a great desire expressed for food, even during the fever to gratify that desire with a moderate amount of simple food would be less injurious than for the patient to be denied. When he can get his mind upon nothing else, nature will not be overburdened with a small portion of simple food.

在高燒的情況下，短期禁食可以降燒，並使水療更有效果。但 主治醫生需要了解病人的實際狀況，不可讓他長期禁食，以致身體 虛弱。高燒的時候，食物就會刺激和興奮血液。但當體溫降低時， 就當謹慎、明智地給病人補充營養。如果禁食太久，胃因渴望食物， · · 反而會產生熱量，這時只有採用適量而良好的食物方可降低其熱度。 這可以供給身體一些運轉的能量。如果病人明顯想吃東西，即便是 在發燒時，也當以適量的、簡單的食物來滿足他的慾望，這會比禁 止他吃飯效果好些。當他的心情不再因食慾而焦灼時，他身心的機 能就不會因少量簡單的食物而過勞了。

在高烧的情况下，短期禁食可以降烧，并使水疗更有效果。但 主治医生需要了解病人的实际状况，不可让他长期禁食，以致身体 虚弱。高烧的时候，食物就会刺激和兴奋血液。但当体温降低时， 就当谨慎、明智地给病人补充营养。如果禁食太久，胃因渴望食物， · · 反而会产生热量，这时只有采用适量而良好的食物方可降低其热度。 这可以供给身体一些运转的能量。如果病人明显想吃东西，即便是 在发烧时，也当以适量的、简单的食物来满足他的欲望，这会比禁 止他吃饭效果好些。当他的心情不再因食欲而焦灼时，他身心的机 能就不会因少量简单的食物而过劳了。
923: Those who take the lives of others in their hands must be men who have been marked as making life a success. They must be men of judgment and wisdom, men who can sympathize and feel to the depths, men whose whole being is stirred when they witness suffering. Some men who have been unsuccessful in every other enterprise in life take up the business of a physician. They take the lives of men and women in their hands, when they have had no experience. They read a plan which somebody has followed with success, and adopt it, and then practice upon those who have confidence in them, actually destroying the last spark of life; yet after all they do not learn anything, but will go on just as sanguine in the next case, observing the same rigid treatment. Some persons may have a power of constitution sufficient to withstand the terrible tax imposed upon them, and live. Then the novices take the glory to themselves, when none is due them. Everything is due to God and to a powerful constitution.

那些掌握別人生命的人，必須是生活上成功的人。他們應當有 見識和智慧，能對人深表同情，見到人受苦便大發惻隱之心。一些 在人生的其它事業上一事無成的人竟作起了醫生。他們在還沒有什 麼經驗的時候，竟將別人的性命操在自己手中。他們看到別人成功 的方案，便拿過來照搬，實行在那些信賴他們的人身上，撲滅了這 些人最後一點生命的火花；可是他們畢竟不學無術，卻會挺有自信 地故伎重演，實施同樣嚴格僵化的治療。有些人的體能足以抵抗強 加於他們的這種可怕治療，且活了下來。於是這些新手便將榮耀歸 於自己，其實他們誰也不配得。那些人得康復完全是由於上帝和他 們強壯的體質。

那些掌握别人生命的人，必须是生活上成功的人。他们应当有 见识和智慧，能对人深表同情，见到人受苦便大发恻隐之心。一些 在人生的其它事业上一事无成的人竟作起了医生。他们在还没有什 么经验的时候，竟将别人的性命操在自己手中。他们看到别人成功 的方案，便拿过来照搬，实行在那些信赖他们的人身上，扑灭了这 些人最后一点生命的火花；可是他们毕竟不学无术，却会挺有自信 地故伎重演，实施同样严格僵化的治疗。有些人的体能足以抵抗强 加于他们的这种可怕治疗，且活了下来。于是这些新手便将荣耀归 于自己，其实他们谁也不配得。那些人得康复完全是由于上帝和他 们强壮的体质。
924: Brother C has been occupying an unworthy position in standing as a prop for B. He has been mind for him, and has stood by to sustain and back him up. C 弟兄一直處在不合適的位置——作 B 弟兄的支柱，替他思考， 站在他旁邊，作他的後盾。這兩個人在健康改良的問題上是狂熱盲 信的。C 弟兄自視甚高，他是在自己欺騙自己。他在實行自己的見 解上是自私而且頑固的。他不是一個受教的人。他的意志沒有降服。 他不是一個心地謙卑的人。這樣的人決不能擔任醫生之職。他或許 透過讀書得了一點知識，但這還遠遠不夠。醫生必須具有經驗。我 們的人太少，不能被這麼卑鄙可恥地犧牲掉，遭受這種人的試驗。 他們若不放棄自己嚴格僵化的見解和主張，承認自己的罪，並且 從經驗中學到教訓，就會有許多寶貴的人成為他們的犧牲品。

C 弟兄一直处在不合适的位置——作 B 弟兄的支柱，替他思考， 站在他旁边，作他的后盾。这两个人在健康改良的问题上是狂热盲 信的。C 弟兄自视甚高，他是在自己欺骗自己。他在实行自己的见 解上是自私而且顽固的。他不是一个受教的人。他的意志没有降服。 他不是一个心地谦卑的人。这样的人决不能担任医生之职。他或许 通过读书得了一点知识，但这还远远不够。医生必须具有经验。我 们的人太少，不能被这么卑鄙可耻地牺牲掉，遭受这种人的试验。 他们若不放弃自己严格僵化的见解和主张，承认自己的罪，并且 从经验中学到教训，就会有许多宝贵的人成为他们的牺牲品。
925: Brother C is too set and willful, and too unteachable for the Lord to use to do any special work in His cause. He is too stubborn to let a few sacrificed lives change his course. He would maintain his views and notions all the more earnestly. These men will yet learn to their sorrow that they might better be teachable, and not drive their extreme views, whatever the result may be. The community will be just as well off, and a little safer upon the whole, if both these men obtain employment in some other business where life and health will not be endangered by their course of action.

C 弟兄过于顽固、任性、不受教，以致我们的主无法使用他在 祂的圣工上作成任何特别的工作。他太顽梗，一些人已经命丧他手， 而这仍不足以使他改变自己的做法。他反倒更加热切地坚持自己的 · · 观点和主意。这些人将要悲哀地认识到，他们最好受教，不要推进 自己的极端见解，无论结果如何。如果这两个人从事别的某种职业， 不会因他们的行为危及他人的生命和健康，社区才会幸免于难，社 会才会安全一些。
926: It is a great responsibility to take the life of a human being in hand. And to have that precious life sacrificed through mismanagement is dreadful. The case of Brother D’s family is terrible. These men may excuse their course; but that will not save the cause of God from reproach, nor bring back that son who suffered and died for the want of food. A little good wine and food would have brought him up from a bed of death and given him back to his family. The father also would soon have been numbered with the dead if the same course had been continued which had been pursued toward the son, but the presence and timely counsel of a doctor from the Health Institute saved him.

將別人的生命操之在手，這實在是責任重大！因處理不當而使 別人喪命更是可怕！ D 弟兄家的情形很糟糕。這些人或許能給自己 開脫，但那不能使上帝的聖工免受指摘，也不會使那因缺少食物而 死去的那個兒子再活過來。一點上好的葡萄汁和食物原會使他脫離 死亡，讓他的家庭免遭喪子之痛。如果施行在兒子身上的手段繼續 用在父親身上，則這作父親的不久也要命喪黃泉了。幸而有一名來 自保健院的醫生光臨並且給出了及時的忠告，才救他免於死亡。

将别人的生命操之在手，这实在是责任重大！因处理不当而使 别人丧命更是可怕！ D 弟兄家的情形很糟糕。这些人或许能给自己 开脱，但那不能使上帝的圣工免受指摘，也不会使那因缺少食物而 死去的那个儿子再活过来。一点上好的葡萄汁和食物原会使他脱离 死亡，让他的家庭免遭丧子之痛。如果施行在儿子身上的手段继续 用在父亲身上，则这作父亲的不久也要命丧黄泉了。幸而有一名来 自保健院的医生光临并且给出了及时的忠告，才救他免于死亡。
927: It is time that something was done to prevent novices from taking the field and advocating health reform. Their works and words can be spared; for they do more injury than the wisest and most intelligent men, with the best influence they can exert, can counteract. It is impossible for the best qualified advocates of health reform to fully relieve the minds of the public from the prejudice received through the wrong course of these extremists and to place the great subject of health reform upon a right basis in the community where these men have figured. The door is also closed in a great measure, so that unbelievers cannot be reached by the present truth upon the Sabbath and the soon coming of our Saviour. The most precious truths are cast aside by the people as unworthy of a hearing. These men are referred to as representatives of health reformers and Sabbathkeepers in general. A great responsibility rests upon those who have thus proved a stumbling block to unbelievers.

現在應當設法阻止那些新手參加倡導健康改良的工作，必須終 止他們的行為和言論。因為他們所發揮的影響和危害，即便是那些 最聰明、最能幹的人用其最佳的感化力，也難以抵消。現今最有資 格倡導健康改良的人，也不能完全消除大眾因這些極端者的錯誤行 動而得的成見。他們無法使健康改良的真理在這些人所生活的社群 內佔有正當的地位。大部分門戶已被關閉，以致關於安息日和我們 的救主快來的現代真理無法達於那些不信的人。那最寶貴的真理已 被人棄絕，人們對其不屑一顧。這些人一般被稱為是守安息日和健 康改良者的代表。那些成為不信之人絆腳石的人，真是應負嚴重的 責任。

现在应当设法阻止那些新手参加倡导健康改良的工作，必须终 止他们的行为和言论。因为他们所发挥的影响和危害，即便是那些 最聪明、最能干的人用其最佳的感化力，也难以抵消。现今最有资 格倡导健康改良的人，也不能完全消除大众因这些极端者的错误行 动而得的成见。他们无法使健康改良的真理在这些人所生活的社区 内占有正当的地位。大部分门户已被关闭，以致关于安息日和我们 的救主快来的现代真理无法达于那些不信的人。那最宝贵的真理已 被人弃绝，人们对其不屑一顾。这些人一般被称为是守安息日和健 康改良者的代表。那些成为不信之人绊脚石的人，真是应负严重的 责任。
92: God calls for separation from the world. Will you obey? Will you come out from among them, and remain separate and distinct from them? “For what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?” You cannot mingle with worldlings, and partake of their spirit, and follow their example, and be at the same time a child of God. The Creator of the universe addresses you as an affectionate Father. If you separate from the world in your affections, and remain free from its contamination, escaping the corruption that is in the world through lust, God will be your Father, He will adopt you into His family, and you will be His heir. In place of the world, He will give you, for a life of obedience, the kingdom under the whole heavens. He will give you an eternal weight of glory and a life that is as enduring as eternity.

上帝要求我們與世俗分別。你願意聽從嗎？你願意從他們中間 出來，並且保持與他們分別且截然不同嗎？“義和不義有什麼相交 呢？光明和黑暗有什麼相通呢”（林後 6:14）？你不能與世俗之人 摻雜、沾染他們的精神、隨從他們的樣子，而同時還作上帝的孩子。 宇宙的創造主就像一位慈愛的父親一樣對你說話。你若在自己的感 情上與世俗分別，不沾染世俗的汙穢，逃避世上從情慾來的敗壞， 上帝就要作你的父，祂要接納你為祂家裡的人，你也要作祂的後嗣。 你若度一種順從的生活，上帝就要把諸天之下的國度賜給你，代替 這個世界。祂必賜你極重無比永遠的榮耀和像永恆一樣長久的生命。 · ·

93: Your heavenly Father proposes to make you a member of the royal family, that through His exceeding great and precious promises you may be a partaker of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. 你所蒙的呼召是崇高的，提拔人的，要你在屬上帝的身子和心 靈上榮耀祂。你不要用別人來衡量你自己。上帝的聖言已經為你提 供了一個毫無過失的模範，一個沒有缺點的榜樣。你懼怕十字架。 它是一個不方便背起的器具，因為它上面覆著責罵和羞恥，你就避 開了它。你需要在生活中施行健康改良；要剋制自己，或吃、或喝 都要為榮耀上帝而行。要禁戒肉體的私慾，這私慾是與靈魂爭戰的。 你需要實行凡事節制。這是你已避開的一個十字架。你要約束自己， 採用簡單的飲食，這會保持你處於最佳的健康狀態，這對你來說是 一個任務。要是你實行了上天允許照在你人生路途上的亮光，你家 中原可免去許多痛苦。你自己的做法已帶來了必然的結果。你在繼 續這種做法時，上帝就不願進入你的家庭，特別祝福你，且行一個 神蹟來拯救你家脫離痛苦。簡單的飲食，沒有辛香料、肉食和各種 油脂，這對你來說會證明是一種福氣，也會救你妻子脫離極大的痛 苦、憂傷和沮喪。

96: In order to render to God perfect service, you must have clear conceptions of His requirements. You should use the most simple food, prepared in the most simple manner, that the fine nerves of the brain be not weakened, benumbed, or paralyzed, making it impossible for you to discern sacred things, and to value the atonement, the cleansing blood of Christ, as of priceless worth. “Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain. And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible. I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air: but I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.”

你若想為上帝獻上完全的服務，就必須清楚地瞭解祂的要求。 你應該採用最簡單的食物，以最簡單的方式製備，好使你大腦纖細 的神經不會削弱、麻木或麻痺，令你無法辨別神聖的事物，不能評 估基督潔淨、贖罪寶血的無限價值。“豈不知在場上賽跑的都跑， 但得獎賞的只有一人？你們也當這樣跑，好叫你們得著獎賞。凡較 力爭勝的，諸事都有節制，他們不過是要得能壞的冠冕；我們卻是 要得不能壞的冠冕。所以，我奔跑，不像無定向的；我鬥拳，不像 打空氣的。我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我傳福音給別人，自己 反被棄絕了”（林前 9:24-27）。

你若想为上帝献上完全的服务，就必须清楚地了解祂的要求。 你应该采用最简单的食物，以最简单的方式制备，好使你大脑纤细 的神经不会削弱、麻木或麻痹，令你无法辨别神圣的事物，不能评 估基督洁净、赎罪宝血的无限价值。“岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑， 但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。凡较 力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是 要得不能坏的冠冕。所以，我奔跑，不像无定向的；我斗拳，不像 打空气的。我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我传福音给别人，自己 反被弃绝了”（林前 9:24-27）。
97: If men, for no higher object than a wreath or perishable crown as a reward of their ambition, subjected themselves to temperance in all things, how much more should those be willing to practice self-denial who profess to be seeking, not only a crown of immortal glory, but a life which is to endure as long as the throne of Jehovah, and riches that are eternal, honors which are imperishable, an eternal weight of glory. 98: If the exceeding precious and glorious reward promised will not lead us to welcome greater privations and endure greater self-denial than are cheerfully borne by worldly men who are seeking merely a bauble of earth, a perishable laurel which brings honors from a few of the worldly, and hate from more, we are unworthy of everlasting life. The treasure we are seeking is imperishable, eternal, immortal, all overglorious; while that of which the worldling is in pursuit, endures but a day; it is fading, perishable, fleeting as the morning cloud.

In adversity, privation, and sorrow it will be a strength and a staff to you. You will find it all hung with mercy, compassion, sympathy, and inexpressible love. May you be able to say with Paul: “God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.”

十字架！十字架！ D 弟兄啊，背起它來！你高舉十字架時，就 會驚奇地發現它高舉你，支援你。在逆境、窮乏、憂傷中，它會成 為你的力量和支柱。你會發現它上面掛滿了仁慈、憐憫、同情，和 無可言喻的愛。十字架會向你證明，它會證明是你不朽的保證。願 你能和保羅一起說：“我斷不以別的誇口，只誇我們主耶穌基督的 十字架。因這十字架，就我而論，世界已經釘在十字架上；就世界 而論，我已經釘在十字架上”（加 6:14）。

100: The Spirit of the Lord has been striving with your wife for some time. If you would yield all to God, she would have strength to take her position to seek to live out the truth. If you choose to turn from the truth, you will not go down alone; you will not only lose your own soul, but will be the means of turning others out of the way, and the blood of souls will be on your garments. Had you maintained your integrity, your mother, your brother E, and one who now hovers over the brink of the grave, might now be enjoying the consolation of the Spirit of God and have a good experience in the truth. Ever bear in mind that we are accountable for the influence we exert. Our influence gathers with Christ or scatters abroad. We are either helping souls in the narrow path of holiness or we are a hindrance, a stumbling block to them, turning them out of the way. You, my much-esteemed brother, have no time to lose. Be in earnest to redeem the time, because the days are evil. Your associates, those whose company you have chosen, have been a hindrance to you. Come out from among them, and be separate. Draw near to God, and come into closer union with His people. Let your interest and your affections center in Christ and His followers. Love those best who love Christ most. Sever the links which have bound you to those who love not God and the truth. What communion hath light with darkness? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

主的靈與你的妻子相爭已有一段時間。你若願意全然順服上帝， 你妻子原會有力量採取立場，努力實行真理。你若選擇背離真理， 墮落的就不會只你一人；你不僅會失喪自己的靈魂，也會成為使別 人轉離正路的手段，你的衣服上就會沾有生靈的血。要是你保持你 的純正，你的母親，你的弟兄 E，和一個即將入土的人，現在就可 享有上帝之靈的安慰，在真理上擁有上好的經驗。總要記住，我們 要為自己所發揮的影響負責。我們的影響不是與基督同收聚的，就 是與祂分散的。我們不是幫助人行走在聖潔的窄路上，便是成為阻 礙，成為他們的絆腳石，使他們轉離正路。我非常尊敬的弟兄啊， 你已經沒有時間再浪費了。你要認真地愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代 邪惡。你的同伴，就是你選擇與之交往的人，一直是你的障礙。要 從他們中間出來，與他們分別。你要親近上帝，與祂的子民有更緊 密的聯合。讓你的興趣和感情集中在基督和跟隨祂的人身上。愛那 些最好最愛基督的人。斬斷將你與那些不愛上帝和真理的人聯絡在 一起的鎖鏈。光明和黑暗有什麼相通呢？信主的和不信主的有什麼 相干呢？

101: You are in imminent danger of making shipwreck of faith. You need all the strength which you can obtain from the people of God, those who possess hope, courage, and faith. But do not neglect prayer, secret prayer. Be instant in prayer; encourage a spirit of true devotion. In your business career you have a work to do. A just and impartial God is to determine all our cases, every event of our life history. “He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.”

你現在面臨著信心破滅的危險。你需要能從上帝的子民那裡 獲得的全部力量，就是那些擁有希望、勇氣和信心的人。不要忽略 禱告，私下的禱告。禱告要恆切，鼓勵一種真虔誠的精神。你在自 己的商業生涯上也有一番工夫要下。具體是什麼，我不能告訴你， · · 但有些事情是錯誤的。你要細細思量檢討。我們正在為永恆工作。 我們所有的言行都要被稱在聖所的天平上。公正無私的上帝要判定 我們一切的情形，我們生活史上的每一件事。“人在最小的事上忠 心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不義，在大事上也不義”（路 16:10）。

102: Let nothing obstruct your progress in the way to everlasting life. Your eternal interest is at stake. There must be a thorough work wrought in you. You must be fully converted, or you will fail of heaven. But Jesus invites you to make Him your strength, your support. He will be to you a present help in every time of need. He will be to you as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land. Let it not be your great anxiety to succeed in this world, but let the burden of your soul be: How shall I secure the better world? what have I to do to be saved? In saving your own soul, you save others. In lifting yourself, you lift others. In fastening your grasp upon the truth and upon the throne of God, you aid others to fix their trembling faith upon His promises and His eternal throne. The position you must come into is to value salvation dearer than earthly gain, to count everything but loss that you may win Christ. The consecration on your part must be entire. God will admit of no reserve, of no divided sacrifice; you can cherish no idol. You must die to self and to the world. Renew your consecration to God daily. Everlasting life is worth a lifelong, persevering, untiring effort.

不要讓任何事成為你追求永生的障礙。你永遠的利益危如累卵。 你必須在心裡作一番徹底的工作。你必須完全轉變，否則你將失去 天國。但耶穌邀請你將祂作為你的力量和支援。祂願作你隨時的幫 助。祂對你願像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。不要再苦心思慮在今生 屬世的事業上獲得成功，你心靈的負擔應該是：我如何才能確保獲 得那更佳美的世界？我必須做什麼才能得救呢？你在救自己靈魂的 同時，也在救別人。你在振奮自己的同時，也振奮別人。你在緊握 真理和上帝寶座的同時，也幫助別人將他們顫抖的信心固定在上帝 的應許和祂永恆的寶座上。你所必須進入的位置，是重視救恩過於 一切屬世的利益，將萬事當作有損的，為要得著基督。你必須完全 獻身。上帝只承認毫無保留、全心全意的犧牲；你心中不能懷藏任 何偶像。你必須向自我和世界死去，每天重新獻身於上帝。永生值 得我們畢生不息不倦的恆切努力。

不要让任何事成为你追求永生的障碍。你永远的利益危如累卵。 你必须在心里作一番彻底的工作。你必须完全转变，否则你将失去 天国。但耶稣邀请你将祂作为你的力量和支持。祂愿作你随时的帮 助。祂对你愿像大磐石的影子在疲乏之地。不要再苦心思虑在今生 属世的事业上获得成功，你心灵的负担应该是：我如何才能确保获 得那更佳美的世界？我必须做什么才能得救呢？你在救自己灵魂的 同时，也在救别人。你在振奋自己的同时，也振奋别人。你在紧握 真理和上帝宝座的同时，也帮助别人将他们颤抖的信心固定在上帝 的应许和祂永恒的宝座上。你所必须进入的位置，是重视救恩过于 一切属世的利益，将万事当作有损的，为要得着基督。你必须完全 献身。上帝只承认毫无保留、全心全意的牺牲；你心中不能怀藏任 何偶像。你必须向自我和世界死去，每天重新献身于上帝。永生值 得我们毕生不息不倦的恒切努力。
103: I was shown that your brother had been convinced of the truth for some time, but influences had held him back. His wife had hindered him from obeying his convictions. But in her affliction she sought the Lord, and He was found of her. Then she felt an anxiety that her husband should embrace the truth; she repented that she had opposed him, that her pride and love of the world had so long kept him from receiving the truth. Like a weary child in search of rest but unable to obtain it, she at length complied with the gracious invitation: “Come unto Me, all ye that labor and are heavy-laden, and I will give you rest.” Her weary, burdened soul sought her Lord, and with repentance, humiliation, and earnest prayer she cast her burden upon the great Burden Bearer, and in Him found rest; she received the evidence that her humiliation and earnest repentance were accepted of God, and that for Christ’s sake He had forgiven her sins.

我蒙指示看到，你的兄弟有段時間曾信服真理，但各種勢力阻 止了他。他妻子曾阻礙他順從自己的確信。但她在自己的痛苦中尋 求上帝，上帝也讓她尋見了。於是她急切地感到，自己的丈夫應該 接受真理。她因曾經反對他而懊悔，因為她驕傲和貪愛世界的心曾 長久地攔阻他接受真理。她像一個苦苦尋求安息卻無法尋得的孩子， 最終順從了恩典的邀請：“凡勞苦擔重擔的人，可以到我這裡來， 我就使你們得安息”（太 11:28）。她疲乏負重的心靈尋見了她的主， 她以痛悔、謙卑和懇切的祈禱，將自己的重擔卸給了那偉大的擔負 重擔者，並在祂裡面尋得了安息。她得到了憑據，她的謙卑和誠心 悔改必已蒙上帝悅納，祂已因基督的緣故赦免了她的罪。

104: I was shown, Brother D, that you have but a short time to work. Do up your work thoroughly, redeem the time. In your business transactions let not a blot tarnish your Christian character. Keep your garments unspotted from the world. Watch and pray, lest you enter into temptation. Temptations may be all around you, but you are not compelled to enter into them. You may obtain strength from Christ to stand unsullied amid the pollutions of this corrupt age. “Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.” Keep the eye steadily fixed upon Christ, upon the divine image. Imitate His spotless life, and you will be a partaker of His glory, and with Him inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

· · D 弟兄，我蒙指示看到，你只有很短的時間可以工作。你要徹 底作成自己的工，愛惜光陰。在你的商業事務中，不要讓一個汙點 玷汙你的基督徒品格。不要讓你的衣服沾染世俗的汙穢。你要警醒 禱告，免得進入試探。你身邊也許盡都是試探，但誰也不會強迫你 進入試探。你可以從基督獲得力量，在這個敗壞世代的汙穢中一塵 不染地站立。“因此，祂已將又寶貴、又極大的應許賜給我們，叫 我們既脫離世上從情慾來的敗壞，就得與上帝的性情有份”（彼後 1:4）。你要保守自己的眼目堅定地注視基督，注視那神聖的形像。 效法祂無瑕無疵的生活，你就會與祂的榮耀有份，並與祂一同繼承 那從創世以來就為你預備的國。

142: The second effect of tea drinking is headache, wakefulness, palpitation of the heart, indigestion, trembling of the nerves, with many other evils. “I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.” God calls for a living sacrifice, not a dead or dying one. When we realize the requirements of God, we shall see that He requires us to be temperate in all things. The end of our creation is to glorify God in our bodies and spirits, which are His. How can we do this when we indulge the appetite to the injury of the physical and moral powers? God requires that we present our bodies a living sacrifice. Then the duty is enjoined on us to preserve that body in the very best condition of health, that we may comply with His requirements. “Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.”

飲茶的第二種影響，便是頭痛，失眠，心悸，不消化，神經顫 動，以及其它許多害處。“所以弟兄們，我以上帝的慈悲勸你們， 將身體獻上，當作活祭，是聖潔的，是上帝所喜悅的，你們如此侍 奉，乃是理所當然的”（羅 12:1）。上帝要的是活潑健康的祭物， 而不是死的或瀕於死亡的。我們何時認識到上帝的要求，就會看到 祂吩咐我們在凡事上實行節制。我們受造的目的是在我們屬祂的身 子和心靈上榮耀上帝。我們若因放縱食慾而損害身體和道德的力量， · · 又怎能做到這樣呢？上帝要求我們將身體當作活祭獻上。因而我們 奉命要盡的本分，就是保持身體處於最佳的健康狀態，以便我們順 從祂的要求。“所以，你們或吃或喝，無論作什麼，都要為榮耀上 帝而行”（林前 10:31）。

饮茶的第二种影响，便是头痛，失眠，心悸，不消化，神经颤 动，以及其它许多害处。“所以弟兄们，我以上帝的慈悲劝你们， 将身体献上，当作活祭，是圣洁的，是上帝所喜悦的，你们如此侍 奉，乃是理所当然的”（罗 12:1）。上帝要的是活泼健康的祭物， 而不是死的或濒于死亡的。我们何时认识到上帝的要求，就会看到 祂吩咐我们在凡事上实行节制。我们受造的目的是在我们属祂的身 子和心灵上荣耀上帝。我们若因放纵食欲而损害身体和道德的力量， · · 又怎能做到这样呢？上帝要求我们将身体当作活祭献上。因而我们 奉命要尽的本分，就是保持身体处于最佳的健康状态，以便我们顺 从祂的要求。“所以，你们或吃或喝，无论作什么，都要为荣耀上 帝而行”（林前 10:31）。
143: You have a work to do to set your house in order. Cleanse yourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God. You should make earnest efforts to discover your errors, and in the fear of God, relying upon His strength, put them away. Dear brother and sister, you need to reform in the matter of order. You should cultivate a love for neatness and strict cleanliness. God is a God of order. He will not sanction slack and disorderly habits in any of His people. In your dress, in your house, in all things, manifest taste and order. We are looked upon as a peculiar people. The dress reform is a striking contrast to the fashion of the world. Those who adopt this dress should manifest good taste and order and strict cleanliness in all their attire. The dress should not be adopted unless it is made right and arranged neatly. For we should seek not to disgust unbelievers by carelessness and slackness in our apparel, but should dress modestly, with reference to health and neatness, that our dress may commend itself to the judgment of candid minds.

你要下一番工夫使家中井然有序。潔淨自己身體心靈的一切汙 穢，敬畏上帝，得以成聖。你當盡力發現自己的錯誤，存敬畏上帝 的心，倚靠祂的能力去除之。親愛的弟兄和姐妹，你們需要在秩序 方面進行改革。你們應當培養喜愛整潔和嚴格清潔的心。上帝是有 秩序的上帝。祂決不認可祂子民的任何懶散無序的習慣。你要在自 己的服裝、家宅以及所有事情上表現出高尚的品位和秩序。我們被 看作是一班特別的子民。我們的服裝改革與這世界的時尚形成了鮮 明的對比。那些採用這種服裝的人應當在自己一切的服裝上表現出 良好的品位、次序和嚴格的潔淨來。服裝若不正派整潔，我們就不 應穿戴。因為我們不應因服裝的隨便和邋遢而招致不信的人厭惡， 而應適當著裝，考慮健康和整潔，好使我們的服裝給無偏見之人的 判斷留下好印象。

你要下一番工夫使家中井然有序。洁净自己身体心灵的一切污 秽，敬畏上帝，得以成圣。你当尽力发现自己的错误，存敬畏上帝 的心，倚靠祂的能力去除之。亲爱的弟兄和姐妹，你们需要在秩序 方面进行改革。你们应当培养喜爱整洁和严格清洁的心。上帝是有 秩序的上帝。祂决不认可祂子民的任何懒散无序的习惯。你要在自 己的服装、家宅以及所有事情上表现出高尚的品位和秩序。我们被 看作是一班特别的子民。我们的服装改革与这世界的时尚形成了鲜 明的对比。那些采用这种服装的人应当在自己一切的服装上表现出 良好的品位、次序和严格的洁净来。服装若不正派整洁，我们就不 应穿戴。因为我们不应因服装的随便和邋遢而招致不信的人厌恶， 而应适当着装，考虑健康和整洁，好使我们的服装给无偏见之人的 判断留下好印象。
144: You need clear, energetic minds, in order to appreciate the exalted character of the truth, to value the atonement, and to place the right estimate upon eternal things.
